    <title>1.20.2</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>Summary of Changes</h2>
<p><strong>Minor Changes:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>gateway-api: node label selector for when hostNetwork is enabled (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5416355899" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48636" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48636/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48636">#48636</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4970859218" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47463" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47463/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47463">#47463</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/xtineskim/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/xtineskim">@xtineskim</a>)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bugfixes:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>aws/ipam: Fixed a bug where the operator in ENI IPAM mode would try to release prefix IPs as individual IPs even when they were in use. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5328409217" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48418" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48418/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48418">#48418</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5212754176" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48125" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48125/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48125">#48125</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/41ks/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/41ks">@41ks</a>)</li>
<li>aws/ipam: Fixed a bug where the operator would fail to allocate new IPs to nodes with prefix delegation enabled on subnets that ran out of prefixes. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5328409217" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48418" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48418/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48418">#48418</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5236609620" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48193" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48193/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48193">#48193</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/41ks/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/41ks">@41ks</a>)</li>
<li>bpf: Fix agent crash when dumping map events (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5314413166" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48378" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48378/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48378">#48378</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5272633946" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48273" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48273/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48273">#48273</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/joestringer/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/joestringer">@joestringer</a>)</li>
<li>bpf: Fixed a bug where enabling policy-deny-response: icmp would cause metrics for policy denied drops on egress to stop getting reported. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5387241942" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48550" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48550/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48550">#48550</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5324681829" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48407" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48407/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48407">#48407</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/41ks/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/41ks">@41ks</a>)</li>
<li>Cluster Mesh: fix extremely rare race condition that may cause a removed remote cluster to not be correctly disconnected (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5328409217" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48418" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48418/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48418">#48418</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5266601364" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48262" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48262/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48262">#48262</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/giorio94/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/giorio94">@giorio94</a>)</li>
<li>datapath/linux/config: fix IPV4_DIRECT_ROUTING selection on lo device (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5387241942" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48550" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48550/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48550">#48550</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4795198004" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/46861" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/46861/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/46861">#46861</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/fdomain/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/fdomain">@fdomain</a>)</li>
<li>endpoint: preserve concurrent policy updates for new endpoints (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5246627357" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48213" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48213/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48213">#48213</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5237126987" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48195" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48195/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48195">#48195</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/jrajahalme/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/jrajahalme">@jrajahalme</a>)</li>
<li>ENI IPv6: Fix IPv6 routing for health check endpoint, ingress address and for IPSec on ENI interfaces. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5246627357" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48213" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48213/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48213">#48213</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4846479412" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47034" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47034/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47034">#47034</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/41ks/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/41ks">@41ks</a>)</li>
<li>Fix a pod created immediately after a network policy change reporting a stale policy revision for up to two minutes. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5328409217" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48418" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48418/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48418">#48418</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5030497130" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47642" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47642/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47642">#47642</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/aanm/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/aanm">@aanm</a>)</li>
<li>Fix agent crash on startup in ENI IPAM mode when ipv4NativeRoutingCIDR is set to a secondary VPC CIDR association (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5172190879" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48024" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48024/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48024">#48024</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5101833057" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47874" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47874/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47874">#47874</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/bryanhorstmann/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/bryanhorstmann">@bryanhorstmann</a>)</li>
<li>Fix BGP <code>defaultGateway</code> peer auto-discovery selecting a default route from a non-main routing table, such as the <code>default via cilium_host</code> route Cilium installs in the from-proxy table, instead of the node's real default gateway. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5328409217" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48418" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48418/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48418">#48418</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5155016198" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47971" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47971/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47971">#47971</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/ecbaldwin/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/ecbaldwin">@ecbaldwin</a>)</li>
<li>Fix bug where identities may linger for double the amount of the expected time (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5328409217" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48418" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48418/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48418">#48418</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5178433139" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48032" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48032/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48032">#48032</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/christarazi/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/christarazi">@christarazi</a>)</li>
<li>Fix dropping traffic L2Announcement with externalTrafficPolicy: Local (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5387241942" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48550" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48550/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48550">#48550</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4609419107" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/46399" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/46399/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/46399">#46399</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/yuito-it/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/yuito-it">@yuito-it</a>)</li>
<li>Fix Gateway API static IPv6 addresses being reported as unusable when the Gateway and Service use different textual representations of the same address. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5171704152" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48017" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48017/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48017">#48017</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5143174669" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47943" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47943/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47943">#47943</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/taaahaaa/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/taaahaaa">@taaahaaa</a>)</li>
<li>Fix HTTPRoute ExternalAuth to fail closed when its backend reference is invalid or cannot be resolved. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5171704152" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48017" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48017/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48017">#48017</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5139287984" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47929" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47929/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47929">#47929</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/shreyasrajiv327/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/shreyasrajiv327">@shreyasrajiv327</a>)</li>
<li>Fix Hubble Relay remains running during termination (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5387241942" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48550" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48550/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48550">#48550</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5142966314" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47942" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47942/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47942">#47942</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/xandau/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/xandau">@xandau</a>)</li>
<li>Fix ICMP error packet handling by adding the missing checksum recalculation performed during NAT for SNATed load-balanced traffic. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5328409217" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48418" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48418/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48418">#48418</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5193071683" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48086" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48086/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48086">#48086</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/julianwiedmann/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/julianwiedmann">@julianwiedmann</a>)</li>

    <content type="html"><h2>Summary of Changes</h2>
<p><strong>Bugfixes:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>aws/ipam: Fixed a bug where the operator would fail to allocate new IPs to nodes with prefix delegation enabled on subnets that ran out of prefixes. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5401015947" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48607" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48607/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48607">#48607</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5236609620" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48193" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48193/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48193">#48193</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/41ks/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/41ks">@41ks</a>)</li>
<li>bpf: Fix agent crash when dumping map events (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5314456637" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48380" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48380/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48380">#48380</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5272633946" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48273" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48273/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48273">#48273</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/joestringer/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/joestringer">@joestringer</a>)</li>
<li>datapath/linux/config: fix IPV4_DIRECT_ROUTING selection on lo device (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5387530725" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48554" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48554/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48554">#48554</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4795198004" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/46861" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/46861/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/46861">#46861</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/fdomain/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/fdomain">@fdomain</a>)</li>
<li>Fix Hubble Relay remains running during termination (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5387530725" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48554" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48554/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48554">#48554</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5142966314" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47942" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47942/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47942">#47942</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/xandau/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/xandau">@xandau</a>)</li>
<li>Fix missing config setup for 'enable-non-default-deny-policies' flag (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5387530725" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48554" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48554/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48554">#48554</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5318000712" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48391" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48391/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48391">#48391</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/fristonio/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/fristonio">@fristonio</a>)</li>
<li>Fix nodeport egress tuple reuse for closed connections (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5324332774" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48406" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48406/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48406">#48406</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5282754068" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48306" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48306/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48306">#48306</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/fristonio/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/fristonio">@fristonio</a>)</li>
<li>Fix restored ENI endpoints routing rule configuration when masquerading config changes (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5330349824" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48423" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48423/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48423">#48423</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/fristonio/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/fristonio">@fristonio</a>)</li>
<li>fix(socketlb): only detach Cilium-owned cgroup programs (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5387530725" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48554" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48554/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48554">#48554</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3872558760" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/44066" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/44066/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/44066">#44066</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/puwun/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/puwun">@puwun</a>)</li>
<li>Fixed a bug that caused the clustermesh-apiserver etcd users managements logic to not revoke stale roles upon configuration change; users leveraging the configuration provided by the Cilium helm chart are not affected, as the target etcd role is never changed. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5247242973" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48216" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48216/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48216">#48216</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5129705391" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47915" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47915/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47915">#47915</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/giorio94/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/giorio94">@giorio94</a>)</li>
<li>Fixed five configuration options that were accepted but silently ignored: <code>vtep-sync-interval</code>, <code>enable-xt-socket-fallback</code>, <code>eni-delete-on-termination</code> with a custom CNI configuration, the <code>enableIdentityMark</code> Helm value outside CNI chaining mode, and <code>lb-retry-backoff-max</code>. (Backport PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5334583350" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48432" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48432/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48432">#48432</a>, Upstream PR <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5029936766" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47635" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47635/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47635">#47635</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/aanm/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/aanm">@aanm</a>)</li>

    <title>1.21.0-pre.2</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>Summary of Changes</h2>
<p><g-emoji class="g-emoji" alias="warning">⚠️</g-emoji> Due to a release issue, the <code>v1.21.0-pre.1</code> has not been completed, instead we are publishing <code>v1.21.0-pre.2</code>. This changelog contains the changes from <code>v1.21.0-pre.0</code> to <code>v1.21.0-pre.2</code></p>
<p><strong>Major Changes:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Add support for Gateway API session persistence (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5176122543" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48029" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48029/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48029">#48029</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/thorn3r/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/thorn3r">@thorn3r</a>)</li>
<li>Allow use of AWS managed prefix lists in Cilium policies. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4391075045" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/45806" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/45806/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/45806">#45806</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/bodgit/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/bodgit">@bodgit</a>)</li>
<li>Enable BPF masquerading by default (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5028805845" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47631" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47631/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47631">#47631</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/pchaigno/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/pchaigno">@pchaigno</a>)</li>
<li>network driver: add sriov device manager (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4939039515" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47387" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47387/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47387">#47387</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/bersoare/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/bersoare">@bersoare</a>)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Minor Changes:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Add <code>cilium-dbg bpf stats report</code> command to collect and display eBPF program runtime statistics. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4885443921" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47186" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47186/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47186">#47186</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/amchelapurath2023/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/amchelapurath2023">@amchelapurath2023</a>)</li>
<li>aws: Use <code>GetSecurityGroupsForVpc</code> to fetch security groups (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5051286389" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47704" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47704/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47704">#47704</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/HadrienPatte/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/HadrienPatte">@HadrienPatte</a>)</li>
<li>bpf: Support configuring an extended masquerade port range (<code>--node-port-nat-range-ext</code>) for BPF SNAT masquerading. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4916217672" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47301" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47301/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47301">#47301</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/yyyyyymmm/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/yyyyyymmm">@yyyyyymmm</a>)</li>
<li>CiliumPodIPPools now support reservedRanges for multi-pool IPAM. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4801974453" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/46880" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/46880/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/46880">#46880</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/kyounghoonJang/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/kyounghoonJang">@kyounghoonJang</a>)</li>
<li>clustermesh: handle a remote cluster ID change. Also improve cluster ID verification in operator/kvstoremesh similarly to existing agent logic. (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5063366321" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47747" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47747/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47747">#47747</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/MrFreezeex/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/MrFreezeex">@MrFreezeex</a>)</li>
<li>clustermesh: set tls authMode to cluster by default (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5228758344" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/48170" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/48170/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/48170">#48170</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/MrFreezeex/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/MrFreezeex">@MrFreezeex</a>)</li>
<li>envoy: Add support for HTTP CONNECT (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4169381279" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/45051" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/45051/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/45051">#45051</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/nezdolik/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/nezdolik">@nezdolik</a>)</li>
<li>etcd: add new metrics for watch and paginated list calls (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5019253248" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47602" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47602/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47602">#47602</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/odinuge/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/odinuge">@odinuge</a>)</li>
<li>gateway-api: node label selector for when hostNetwork is enabled (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4970859218" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/issues/47463" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/cilium/cilium/pull/47463/hovercard" href="https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/47463">#47463</a>, <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/xtineskim/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/xtineskim">@xtineskim</a>)</li>
<li>Helm: user-supplied annotations now take precedence over the chart's prometheus.io/scrape and prometheus.io/port annotations, which no longer render as duplicate keys.
